summary: Combined DDA+DIA SDRF: all 111 RAW files map correctly to the design sheet (source, growth replicate, acquisition mode, MS batch, subtype); cell-line metadata match the Cellosaurus evidence; no blocker or important issues.

reviewer_context.context: fresh adversarial reviewer agent without producer transcript; evidence limited to scratchpad/PXD029805/, sdrf-skills spec/data, installed templates and ontology caches; no network

spec_compliance.evidence: 42 columns, templates ms-proteomics/human/cell-lines v1.1.0 declared; structure reports mixed-acquisition-methods (expected for the combined file by repo convention, PXD023708); no duplicate rows.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Resolved in local caches (one parquet at a time): MONDO small cell lung carcinoma (0008433), lung large cell carcinoma (0003050), lung carcinoid tumor (0006041); UBERON lung, bone marrow, liver, pleural effusion, lymph node, upper lobe of left lung, uterine cervix, ascitic fluid; CL:0000066 epithelial cell; MS:1002877 Q Exactive HF-X, MS:1001251 trypsin, MS:1001309 Lys-C, MS:1000422 beam-type CID; PRIDE:0000627 DDA, PRIDE:0000450 DIA, PRIDE:0000608 DTT, PRIDE:0000599 IAA; UNIMOD:4/35/1 labels match. Cellosaurus accessions match snapshot rows (verified byte-identical to sdrf-skills data/cl-annotations-db.tsv) or saved API extracts for GLC-4, NCI-N417, NCI-H372, NCI-H82.

source_evidence.evidence: Per-line age/sex/sampling site/disease/cell type checked against snapshot and API extracts for all 28 annotated lines (NCI-H82 41Y from saved API record); subtype per RAW from design sheet; RPMI-1640 from Methods (SCLC lines only); Lys-C+trypsin, DTT, IAA, NCE 28, 10 ppm/0.02 Da, mods from Methods; instrument from RAW headers of both batches and paper. Table 1 origin conflicts (H211, H378, H1694) are disclosed. Reconcile flags are false positives: trypsin/Lys-C are named in paper Methods (PRIDE protocol omits them); organism part 'lung' = tissue of origin per SAMPLE-GUIDELINES.

file_mapping.evidence: 111 rows = 111 PRIDE RAW files (files_compact.json, all URLs PXD029805) = 111 design-sheet rows; no missing, duplicate or non-raw files; assay name = RAW basename.

design_consistency.evidence: Recomputed: 32 sources (29 lines x growth G1/G2), biological replicate 2 only for SCLC02/08/14 G2; 39 DDA + 72 DIA; MS batch 1 = 60, batch 2 = 51 rows matching design 'Batch number'; factor counts A39/N24/P13/Y25/NSCLC7/carcinoid3 match report; reserved-word counts in report verified.

omission_safety.evidence: No value exceeds its evidence: HLHE (no Cellosaurus/Table 1 ID) is 'not available' for accession/name/age/sex/site; culture medium 'not available' for the three non-SCLC lines not covered by Methods; cell type only where the snapshot states it; age 'not available' where Cellosaurus says unspecified. Only interpretive wording is the 'reference line' phenotype (minor finding).

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t human -t cell-lines --use_ols_cache_only (flock-serialized): exit 0, 0 errors; warnings only (27 characteristics[cell line] names not in CLO/BTO/EFO cache, 'RPMI 1640' not in NCIT cache). sdrf-tools check --offline: CLEAN. sdrf-tools score: 100 on specificity/consistency/standards/design.

findings.location: comment[proteomics data acquisition method] / comment[technical replicate]
findings.message: Combined file mixes DDA and DIA runs (sdrf-tools structure: mixed-acquisition-methods) and numbers technical replicates across both acquisition modes (1-6 per source). Expected under the repo convention because -dda/-dia splits are shipped.
findings.evidence: sdrf-tools structure output; split files carry per-mode renumbering.

findings.message: Cell line names mix design-sheet IDs (H209, H1688, GLC4, N417, DMS53, SHP77 ...) with Cellosaurus names substituted for three lines (SW1271 for CRL2177, 'DMS 114' for CRL2066, COR-L311 for COR); 26 of 29 names do not resolve in CLO/BTO/EFO (validator warnings).
findings.evidence: Design sheet 'Cell line ID' column vs characteristics[cellosaurus name]; validator warning list. Correction: use one convention (preferably the Cellosaurus name, e.g. NCI-H209, DMS 53, SHP-77) for every line.

findings.message: 'not applicable' is asserted for every row although each cell line derives from a distinct human donor; 'not available' (or a per-line donor identifier) is the more accurate reserved word.
findings.evidence: human template: individual = donor identifier (recommended); 29 lines = 29 donors.

findings.message: Recommended characteristics[ancestry category] is omitted although the cited snapshot extract gives it for 25 lines (Caucasian; African American for NCI-H1048); optional comment[ms min mz]/[ms max mz] (DDA 375-1500, DIA 375-1455) are stated in Methods but not annotated.
findings.evidence: scratchpad/PXD029805/evidence/cl-annotations-db_extract.tsv 'ancestry category'; manuscript Nano LC-MS/MS section; sdrf-tools score completeness notes.

findings.location: characteristics[phenotype] / factor value[phenotype], SCLC22/SCLC25/SCLC26 rows (10 rows)
findings.message: 'non-small cell lung cancer reference line' and 'lung carcinoid reference line' add a 'reference line' role not stated anywhere: the design sheet says only Subtype NSCLC / CARCINOID and the paper never mentions NCI-H661, NCI-H460 or NCI-H720.
findings.evidence: SCLC_Experimental_design_cell_pellets.xlsx Subtype column; manuscript has no H460/H661/H720 mention. Correction: use the deposited labels (e.g. 'non-small cell lung cancer', 'lung carcinoid') or state the inference in the report.

findings.location: PXD029805.report.md / evidence.json claim on cellosaurus accession
findings.message: The statement that Table 1 'Other cell line ID' resolves 'COR' is inaccurate: COR-L311 is in Table 1's 'Cell line ID' column with Other ID N/A (CRL-2177 and CRL-2066 are in the 'Cell line ID' column, with SW1271 / DMS 114 as Other ID). The resolved accessions themselves are correct.
findings.evidence: manuscript Table 1 rows 'COR-L311 | N/A | SCLC-P', 'CRL-2066 | DMS 114', 'CRL-2177 | SW1271'.
